cumleler: Who should be referred for a cochlear implant evaluation?
At the heart of candidacy is limited benefit from well-fitted hearing aids.
Zwolan and colleagues proposed a simple referral rule.
First, a better-ear average threshold of 60 decibels or worse.
Second, unaided word recognition of 60 percent or less.
It guides referral; the candidacy decision is made by the team.
